# Codex default instructions

`../codex_prompt.md` is an unmodified copy of the Apache-2.0-licensed default prompt from OpenAI Codex CLI `rust-v0.154.0`, `codex-rs/models-manager/prompt.md`.

Source: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.154.0/codex-rs/models-manager/prompt.md
License: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.154.0/LICENSE

The gateway supplies the same default that this client previously used for its unknown `auto` model. Do not strip client/admin approval policy or copy private user instructions into this file. On Codex upgrades, verify the model descriptor and default prompt together with native client tests.
